hook: A condominium building whose 72 apartments are held as 72 separate parcels on block 0210A.

narrative.lead:
946 Stockton Street is a condominium building whose 72 apartments are held as 72 separate parcels — lots 025 through 096 on block 0210A — lettered A through F on each of twelve residential floors, numbered 6 through 18 with no thirteenth.
The same block carries twenty-five commercial store and office condominium parcels, addressed 944 and 950 Stockton Street; the residential units here begin at the sixth floor.
This page's parcel is lot 025, unit 6A, so the assessed value and last sale shown below are that unit's and not the building's.
